image_description: A top-down view of a wooden cutting board featuring two meat cleavers. The top cleaver is new, with a yellow protective paper wrapper covering the upper part of the blade and handle area, showing some text and graphics. The bottom cleaver is older, with a heavily worn, pitted, or stained metal surface, lacking a handle in the visible frame or having a very short/obscured one. The background includes the edge of a blue object in the top left corner.
